videos.title: System Design Primer ⭐️: How to start with distributed systems?
videos.summary: Gaurav Sen lays out a roadmap for learning distributed systems, explaining what scalability means and why you must reason about it before designing anything.

videos.title: System Design BASICS: Horizontal vs. Vertical Scaling
videos.summary: Clear comparison of adding more CPUs/RAM to one machine (vertical) versus adding more machines (horizontal), with trade-offs for each approach.

videos.title: What is LOAD BALANCING? ⚖️
videos.summary: Introduces load balancers, explains round-robin and least-connections strategies, and walks through why they are critical for availability.

videos.title: What is CONSISTENT HASHING and Where is it used?
videos.summary: Explains the problem with naive modulo hashing when nodes change, then introduces the ring-based consistent hashing solution with virtual nodes.

videos.title: Algorithms You Should Know Before System Design Interviews
videos.summary: ByteByteGo surveys the key algorithms behind system design—consistent hashing, bloom filters, Merkle trees, and more—with animated diagrams.

videos.title: B-tree vs B+ tree in Database Systems
videos.summary: Hussein Nasser compares B-tree and B+ tree structures, explaining how they differ in storage of data pointers and why B+ trees dominate relational database indexes.

videos.title: What is Kafka and How does it work?
videos.summary: A beginner-friendly breakdown of Apache Kafka covering topics, partitions, producers, consumers, and consumer groups with real examples.

videos.title: NginX Crash Course
videos.summary: Covers how NGINX works as both a web server and reverse proxy, including configuration for load balancing, TLS termination, and caching static assets.

videos.title: Database Indexes: What do they do? | Systems Design Interview: 0 to 1 with Google Software Engineer
videos.summary: Walks through what a database index is, how B-tree and hash indexes work, and the trade-offs between read performance and write overhead.

videos.title: Vector Databases simply explained! (Embeddings & Indexes)
videos.summary: Explains vector embeddings and how vector databases store and search high-dimensional data using ANN indexes such as HNSW.

videos.title: Design a Distributed Rate Limiter w/ a Ex-Meta Staff Engineer: System Design Breakdown
videos.summary: A Meta staff engineer walks through designing a distributed rate limiter, covering token bucket, sliding window log, Redis-based counters, and multi-region concerns.

videos.title: Message Queues in System Design Interviews w/ Meta Staff Engineer
videos.summary: Explains when and how to introduce a message queue in a system design interview, including fan-out patterns, backpressure, and durability guarantees.

videos.title: Consistent Hashing | Algorithms You Should Know #1
videos.summary: ByteByteGo visualizes consistent hashing with virtual nodes, showing exactly how requests are routed and how node additions or removals minimize key remapping.

videos.title: System Design: Why is Kafka fast?
videos.summary: Dives into the design choices that make Kafka extremely fast: sequential disk I/O, zero-copy data transfer, and batched compression of messages.

videos.title: System Design: Apache Kafka In 3 Minutes
videos.summary: A rapid animated overview of Kafka architecture—brokers, topics, partitions, replication, and consumer groups—ideal for a quick refresher before an interview.

videos.title: All Types of Database Replication Discussed
videos.summary: Hussein Nasser surveys synchronous, asynchronous, logical, and streaming replication, explaining the consistency vs. performance trade-offs for each mode.

videos.title: Database ACID - Live Stream (by Hussein Nasser)
videos.summary: A deep-dive into ACID properties—atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability—showing how relational databases implement each guarantee with real SQL examples.

videos.title: System Design: YouTube (with FAANG Senior Engineer)
videos.summary: A FAANG senior engineer designs a YouTube-like video platform, covering upload pipelines, transcoding, CDN edge caching, and recommendation feed scaling.

videos.title: Atlassian Interview Question | System Design: Rate Limiter (5+ Approaches)
videos.summary: Explores five distinct rate-limiter designs—in-process, Redis-based, sliding window, token bucket, and distributed—weighing each for a real Atlassian interview scenario.

videos.title: 3: Dropbox + Google Drive | Systems Design Interview Questions With Ex-Google SWE
videos.summary: Designs a cloud storage service from scratch, addressing block-level deduplication, metadata storage sharding, sync conflict resolution, and CDN-based delivery.

videos.title: System Design Interview: Design LeetCode (Online Judge) w/ a Ex-Meta Staff Engineer
videos.summary: Step-by-step design of an online judge system, covering problem and submission storage, distributed code execution sandboxes, and result caching.

videos.title: Why RAG Breaks at Scale | Anyscale Webinar
videos.summary: Anyscale engineers diagnose where RAG pipelines fail under production scale, covering chunking strategies, embedding drift, retrieval precision, and async data pipelines.

videos.title: Vector Database Architecture Explained
videos.summary: A thorough walkthrough of vector database internals—HNSW graphs, IVF indexes, quantization, and the trade-offs between recall, latency, and storage.

videos.title: System Design: Facebook Messenger (5+ approaches)
videos.summary: A FAANG senior engineer presents five different chat backend architectures, from simple pub-sub to fan-out-on-read vs. write, with explicit trade-off analysis.

videos.title: System Design Interview: Design Tinder w/ a Ex-Meta Staff Engineer
videos.summary: Deep-dive into a geo-distributed matching service, covering profile storage sharding, geohash-based proximity search, recommendation ranking, and swipe-storm traffic shaping.

videos.title: 5: Netflix + YouTube | Systems Design Interview Questions With Ex-Google SWE
videos.summary: Designs a large-scale video streaming service covering adaptive bitrate streaming, CDN placement strategy, view-count aggregation pipelines, and multi-region replication.

videos.title: The Rise of vLLM: Building an Open Source LLM Inference Engine
videos.summary: The vLLM team traces the design of PagedAttention and continuous batching that made vLLM the dominant open-source LLM serving engine, with throughput benchmarks.

videos.title: Faster Model Serving with Ray and Anyscale | Ray Summit 2024
videos.summary: Covers Ray Serve’s autoscaling, request batching, and multi-GPU deployment patterns for production LLM inference, with cost and latency benchmarks.

videos.title: Anyscale’s Unified Platform for LLM Development and Deployment | Ray Summit 2024
videos.summary: Presents Anyscale’s end-to-end platform for LLM workflows—training, fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, agentic orchestration, and production serving—on Ray.

videos.title: Enabling Cost-Efficient LLM Serving with Ray Serve
videos.summary: Shows how Ray Serve’s fractional GPU sharing, replica autoscaling, and request routing reduce LLM serving cost significantly versus naive single-model deployments.
